      Everything you need to know as Essex's first drive-thru Five Guys opens

      It opened in September and already has many 5 star reviews

      Comments0
      What's On
      Jodie Bradley What's On Reporter
      18:00, 06 Oct 2026
      Listen to audio version of this article
      Sponsored by
      0:00 / 2:20
      Instaread

      Essex's first drive-thru Five Guys has opened, and it's already been receiving a lot of praise from locals. Thurrock already had a Five Guys branch inside Lakeside shopping centre, but its second spot has recently opened.

      ‌

      The new standalone location has opened at West Thurrock retail park in Grays, home to Matalan, Puregym and more. Bosses say that the new site gives Essex food lovers an exciting new way to enjoy their favourite burgers - complete with a dedicated drive-thru and a daily breakfast menu.

      ‌

      Opening its doors seven days a week from 8am to 11pm, customers can enjoy breakfast, lunch and dinner options throughout the day. The new store features state-of-the-art facilities aimed at making ordering seamless for everyone.

      ‌

      £100k worth of outdoor furniture stolen in overnight raid

      Major plans for new road connecting Chelmsford and Southend announced

      It includes self-service digital kiosks, indoor digital display screens and full accessibility features - including complete wheelchair access, dedicated disabled facilities and customer toilets. Guests can enjoy their meal inside the restaurant or take advantage of the outdoor seating area.

      Adam Gayter, Five Guys’ drive-thru specialist, said of the opening: "With our drive-thru feature and early morning breakfast service, we’re making it easier than ever for local fans to enjoy our handcrafted burgers, hand-cut fries and custom milkshakes whenever the craving strikes. We can’t wait to welcome everyone through the door."

      ‌

      Despite only being open for two weeks, it's received high praise from customers. John reviewed the new eatery on Google, saying: "Excellent, friendly customer service. Food was nice and the sauce is real Heinz mayo and ketchup on tap. Milkshakes delicious. Was a pleasant experience thanks to the five guys employees!"

      Lavinia Daraban agreed, saying: "Had such a lovely experience at Five Guys Thurrock! The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, tasty, and cooked perfectly. The burgers and fries were amazing, and you can really taste the quality of the ingredients."
